t: You're looking at numbers 2 to 7 Stratford Place, a group of buildings in Westminster. They were designed by Richard Edwin, a British architect who worked in Marylebone and died in 1778. Numbers 8 to 10 and 12 and 13 are also his work, so this is one of several parts of the same street that he designed. Beyond that, I don't have much more to say, so take a look at the frontage and see how the terrace is put together.
